unit: L7 외부지문 — Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival
sentences: The Pingxi Sky Lantern festival is one of Taiwan's most famous celebrations.
It takes place every year in February or March.
This festival marks the end of the Lunar New Year.
People from all over Taiwan and many visitors from other countries come to the small town of Shifen to take part in this special event.
During the festival, people write their wishes, dreams, and messages of hope on colorful paper lanterns.
Then, they light the lanterns and release them into the night sky.
As hundreds of glowing lanterns float upward, the dark sky becomes bright and magical.
People believe that this tradition brings good luck and happiness for the year ahead.
Families, friends, and tourists all enjoy the peaceful and joyful moments.
The Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival is not only beautiful but also full of meaning—It is time to dream and share hope with others.
